If no socket connection is already configured with the address specified by RemoteAddrPtr, SoAd_SetUniqueRemoteAddr () shall: 1. choose an unused socket connection using the best match algorithm described in [SWS_SoAd_00680] 2. set it to the remote address specified by RemoteAddrPtr 3. set AssignedSoConIdPtr to the index of the chosen socket connection and 4. return E_OK . A socket connection is "unused" if its actual remote address has an IP address wildcard and/or port wildcard.
